messages:
Leah (docs): Heads-up: opened PR to modernize the quota + rate limit examples to the new metering v2 format. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/5234. Can reviewers double-check the HTTP snippet, the SDK example, and the dashboard reference?
Jordan (eng): On it. Quick scan: HTTP example uses "X-Usage-Plan" which we've deprecated. Docs should prefer the JSON metering payload and note the header fallback (X-Redwood-Usage).
Leah (docs): Good catch. I'll switch the snippet to a JSON body example and add a one-line note about the header shim.
Priya (product): Also update the tier bands in the sample calc. The pricing change last week moved Standard to 75k-600k. Can we anchor the example to the public pricing page once marketing publishes it?
Sam (eng-ml): For internal accuracy use internal policy link: https://internal.redwood/policies/metering-2026. Public link will be https://redwood.ai/pricing#metering when live. In the meantime, add a parenthetical: "(see pricing for live bands)".
Nina (devex): Please ensure SDK snippet uses `metering.track({})` call semantics we shipped in SDK v3. Example should be tiny and copy-pastable. Avoid showing long timestamps.
Leah (docs): Will trim the SDK sample to a 3-line snippet and mark language as "js" for the SDK block and "json" for the HTTP block.
Jordan (eng): Grafana link in the doc points at the legacy dashboard. New panel URL: https://grafana.redwood/d/usage/overview?panelId=12. Replace and add alt text note for the screenshot.
Leah (docs): Done. Also added alt: "Graph of daily metered tokens by customer tier".
Priya (product): Migration paragraph request: "If you used X-Usage-Plan header please migrate to v2 JSON metering or the X-Redwood-Usage header. Metering semantics (tokens -> tier mapping) unchanged." Short and clear.
Leah (docs): Added migration blurb and a tiny diff snippet showing old vs new.
Sam (eng-ml): One nit on the sample payload — remove trailing comma after customer_id. Also instead of "tokens" use nested usage type "generation.tokens" to reflect feature tagging.
Leah (docs): Updated payload and pushed. New sample: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_789",
  "usage": { "generation.tokens": 120000 },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-23T16:30:00Z"
}
```
Nina (devex): LGTM for SDK snippet. Suggest adding a one-liner: "SDKs automatically set X-Redwood-Usage; you only need to call metering.track()".
ci-bot: Preview build created for PR 5234 — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/5234 (build 819).
Jordan (eng): Quick l10n check: avoid hard-coded US date formats in the examples; use ISO (which you have). Looks good otherwise.
Priya (product): Approved from Product. Small suggestion: change example tier label from "pro" to "enterprise" in the explanatory paragraph to avoid customer confusion.
Leah (docs): Switched label, updated copy. Planning to merge in ~15m if no objections. Thanks all! :partyparrot:
